description.message: Records a tab's sound (Google Meet, Teams, Zoom or any other) and your microphone, and offers it when a call starts. Kryakl makes the transcript on this computer.

commandToggle.message: Start or stop recording the tab

footer.message: The transcript appears in Kryakl → Transcripts.

noMic.message: Without the microphone: only the others will be in the transcript.

orKey.message: Or $1 on the meeting tab. The tab and your microphone are recorded as two tracks.

micBlocked.message: The microphone is not allowed: your voice will be missing.

lost.message: Part of the recording did not reach Kryakl

sent.message: Sent. The transcript is ready in a few minutes.

micWhy.message: Kryakl records your voice as a track of its own, so the transcript shows where you spoke and where the others did. The sound never leaves this computer: Kryakl transcribes it here.

micDone.message: Done. You can close this tab.

micFailed.message: Did not work: $1. Check that the microphone is allowed in Windows' privacy settings.

errNoSound.message: Chrome did not give the tab's sound: $1

startKryakl.message: Start Kryakl and turn on Transcribe: it makes the text on this computer.

noKey.message: No key is set for it: set one on chrome://extensions/shortcuts. The tab and your microphone are recorded as two tracks.

offers.message: Offer to record when a call starts (Meet, Teams, Zoom, Jitsi, Whereby)

offerOrIcon.message: or click Kryakl's icon on Chrome's bar.

offerIcon.message: Click Kryakl's icon on Chrome's bar (under the puzzle piece if it is hidden).

offerStartKryakl.message: Start Kryakl to record this meeting: it makes the transcript on this computer.

errEngine.message: Kryakl's speech engine is not running: open Kryakl → Recordings and meetings to install or start it

stopsBy.message: It stops by itself about 15 s after you leave the call, at once when the tab closes, or by Kryakl's icon.

stopsByKey.message: It stops by itself about 15 s after you leave the call, at once when the tab closes, or by Kryakl's icon or $1.
